Read the roadmap and search existing issues before submitting.

## Problem and audience

Who needs this, and what is difficult with the current atlas? Give a concrete example.

## Proposed result

Describe what a user should be able to do and how someone could verify it works.

## Alternatives and scope

What existing behavior or simpler approach did you consider? Note any effects on source data, date interpretation, accessibility, accounts, or deployment.

## Supporting context

Link related issues, source material, or optional sketches. Say if you would like to help implement or test it.
